title: Constraint: Instruction Stream Rules
constraints: A stream of 20 opcodes: no opcode more than 5 times, LOAD is never immediately followed by STORE, no two NOPs in a row, and the last instruction is BR or JMP.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Count opcodes with `op.sum() with (int'(item == LOAD)) <= 5`, one line per opcode.
Sequence rules relate `op[i]` and `op[i+1]`. Guard the last index.

examples.check: a LOAD is never directly followed by a STORE
examples.title: hazard

examples.check: the stream ends with a branch or jump
examples.title: end
